## Summary

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api was unhealthy in all production regions after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 18%). Per the release history, v2.3.0 was the most recent production-healthy release.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**. The first attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1; a retry completed the rollout to all regions.
- **Verification:** All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, the service reports **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** Opened a **SEV2** incident (INC-0001) describing the failure, the partial-failure hiccup during rollback, and the verified final state.

Recommendation: the on-call engineer (now paged via the incident) should investigate v2.3.1 before any re-deploy, and the orchestrator error during rollback may be worth a follow-up.
